g.text: a, share of cell type × program pairs with no true change (|true| < 0.05) called changed; dashed line at 0.1. b, share of the drug's program changes (|true| ≥ 0.1) called with the right
sign (blank: no drug program pre-specified: Zhang, Parse). PALM (auto_v2): 90% range excludes 0. Tools: per-type score, t-test (paired where donors have both arms), BH q < 0.1.
Dot: mean over 10 splits (40–49); line: 90% bootstrap interval over splits.
